entries.name: 100 Acre Wood Bouncing Spot Turn in Rare Nut 1
entries.description: After speaking with Owl, collect this nut by being raised by a stump on a log near the seesaw. Step on a raised stump across a log to activate the geyser. Return the nut to Owl.

entries.name: 100 Acre Wood Pooh's House Owl Cheer
entries.description: Talk with Owl at Pooh's House after getting over 100 points in Pooh's Hunny Hunt, over 150 points in Block Tigger, over 40 yards in Pooh's Swing, completing Tigger's Giant Pot in under 30 seconds, and Pooh's Muddy Path in under 5 minutes.
